test_clip_grouping.title: Group a clip into a folder, un-group it, delete the folder

steps.action: Open Media, set the date filter to Last 30 Days, and on the Clips tab tick a clip and choose Group Clips.
steps.expected: A new folder appears on the Folders tab.

steps.action: Open the new folder and choose Remove From Folder on the clip.
steps.expected: The clip returns to the Clips tab and is not deleted.

steps.action: Delete the now-empty folder and confirm.
steps.expected: The folder is gone from the Folders tab and every clip outside it is still listed.

test_clip_rename.title: Rename a clip and rename it back, verifying each commit

steps.action: Open Media, set the date filter to Last 30 Days, open the Clips tab and rename a clip to a temporary name.
steps.expected: A success toast appears and, after a reload, the clip is listed under the new name.

steps.action: Rename it back to its original name.
steps.expected: A success toast appears and, after a reload, the original name is listed again.

test_clip_delete.title: Delete Clip dialog contract, then a real delete

steps.action: Open Media, set the date filter to Last 30 Days, open the Clips tab, open a clip's options menu, choose Delete, then Cancel.
steps.expected: The dialog warns the clip will be deleted permanently and cannot be retrieved; after Cancel the clip is still listed.

steps.action: Choose Delete again and confirm.
steps.expected: The clip is no longer listed.

test_clip_move_to_folder.title: Move a clip into an existing folder, then un-group it back

steps.action: Open Media, set the date filter to Last 30 Days, open the Clips tab, tick a clip, choose Move to Folder and pick an existing folder.
steps.expected: The clip leaves the top-level Clips list.

steps.action: Open that folder and choose Remove From Folder on the clip.
steps.expected: The clip is listed on the Clips tab again.

test_clip_create_link.title: Verify the Create Link dialog opens for a clip

steps.action: Open Media, set the date filter to Last 30 Days, open the Clips tab, open a clip's options menu and choose Create Link.
steps.expected: The Create Link dialog opens with Add Link Name, Set Expiration and Duration fields.

steps.action: Click Cancel.
steps.expected: The dialog closes and no link is created.

test_add_clip_to_vault.title: Vault a clip: its row moves from Clips to the Vault tab

steps.action: Open Media, set the date filter to Last 30 Days, open the Clips tab, open a clip's options menu and choose Add to Vault.
steps.expected: The action is confirmed.

steps.action: Reload the page and open the Vault tab.
steps.expected: The clip is listed in the Vault.

test_remove_clip_from_vault.title: Un-vault a clip: its row returns to the Clips tab

steps.action: Open Media, set the date filter to Last 30 Days; vault a clip from the Clips tab, reload, and open the Vault tab.
steps.expected: The clip is listed in the Vault.

steps.action: On the Vault tab choose Remove from Vault on that clip, reload, and open the Clips tab.
steps.expected: The clip is listed on the Clips tab again and no longer in the Vault.

test_folder_delete.title: Held by design: folder deletion is covered end to end by

steps.action: Open Media, set the date filter to Last 30 Days, open the Folders tab, open a folder's options menu, choose Delete and confirm.
steps.expected: The folder is removed from the Folders tab (the automated check runs inside the clip grouping case, on a folder the automation created).

test_folder_create_link.title: Verify the Create Link dialog opens for a folder

steps.action: Open Media, set the date filter to Last 30 Days, and on the Clips tab tick a clip and choose Group Clips.
steps.expected: A new folder holding the clip appears on the Folders tab.

steps.action: Open that folder's options menu and choose Create Link.
steps.expected: The Create Link dialog opens with a Set Expiration field.

steps.action: Click Cancel.
steps.expected: The dialog closes and no link is created.

steps.action: Remove the clip from the folder and delete the folder.
steps.expected: The clip is back on the Clips tab and the folder is gone.

test_add_folder_to_vault.title: Vault a folder: its row moves to the Vault tab

steps.action: Open Media, set the date filter to Last 30 Days, open the Folders tab, open a folder's options menu and choose Add to Vault.
steps.expected: The action is confirmed.

steps.action: Reload the page and open the Vault tab.
steps.expected: The folder is listed in the Vault.

test_remove_folder_from_vault.title: Un-vault a folder: its row returns to the Folders tab

steps.action: Open Media, set the date filter to Last 30 Days; vault a folder from the Folders tab, reload, and open the Vault tab.
steps.expected: The folder is listed in the Vault.

steps.action: Choose Remove from Vault on that folder, reload, and open the Folders tab.
steps.expected: The folder is listed on the Folders tab again and no longer in the Vault.

steps.action: Open Media, set the date filter to Last 30 Days, and on the Clips tab tick a clip and choose Group Clips.
steps.expected: A new folder holding the clip appears on the Folders tab.

steps.action: Click Share on that folder's row, enter an e-mail address and send.
steps.expected: A success panel confirms the folder was shared.

steps.action: Remove the clip from the folder and delete the folder.
steps.expected: The clip is back on the Clips tab and the folder is gone.

test_folder_export.title: Export a folder; the export control leaving is the signal

steps.action: Open Media, set the date filter to Last 30 Days, and on the Clips tab tick a clip and choose Group Clips.
steps.expected: A new folder holding the clip appears on the Folders tab.

steps.action: Click Export on that folder's row and confirm.
steps.expected: The export starts, and its progress control finishes and disappears.

steps.action: Remove the clip from the folder and delete the folder.
steps.expected: The clip is back on the Clips tab and the folder is gone.
